scientific_integrity: Entire asserted all-length theorem has a symbolic proof and exact-integer finite checks; neither code nor a same-model review is independent mathematical validation. The oldest cited Jacobsthal square-sum paper is supporting context; the 2022 GCD-of-sliding-squares paper is the primary problem-direction source.
scientific_limitations: Standard Jacobsthal and Jacobsthal-Lucas sequences, squared powers, lengths k>=1, starts n>=1 only; no extension to other recurrences or higher powers claimed. A publicly listed but unavailable 2023 Jacobsthal sliding-GCD research project is a residual originality risk.
title: Exact sliding-square GCDs for the Jacobsthal companion pair
